summary: We are obviously in a very unique moment with agents. Was a delight to be invited by @Microsoft to their reveal today of several new agentic capabilities for Windows and to talk to @satyanadella and @JensenHuang . - MXC containers - a local sandbox for agentic execution. - https://t.co/3stjj0rHtp
